title: New Membership Features: Annual Plans & Prescription Discounts
body_markdown:
Our team is constantly developing improvements and updates to make your membership a better value for your family. As we start a new year, we’re reaching another milestone in that journey with two new exciting features - **annual pricing plans** and **prescription discounts with GoodRx.com** .


## Annual Pricing Plans:


We've gotten many, many requests for this, and after a lot of hard work from our engineering team, we're happy to announce our new multi-month pricing plans.


We know it's often more convenient to pay annually vs. monthly, and has the added benefit of a lower overall cost. To take advantage of this just[log in to your account](https://app.blueberrypediatrics.com/login) , go to the 'Account' page, and use the 'Membership Plan' card to upgrade your membership to the 12-month plan.


## Prescription Discounts with Your GoodRx Card:


We’re also excited to announce a partnership with[GoodRx.com](https://www.goodrx.com/) . Through this partnership, every Blueberry member has access to discounts on prescription medication through GoodRx using the GoodRx card included in your account. You can find it in the App or website under the header 'Savings Card'.


These discounts can help with the cost of prescription treatments, including teen weight-management medication. For a full breakdown, see[the cost of teen weight-loss medication](https://www.blueberrypediatrics.com/health-tips/teen-weight-loss-medication-cost) .


## More to Come:


More features are always on the way, and if there’s anything you’d like to see that would make your membership experience better, always feel free tolet us know .
